data.name: e2e-ui-audit-gromacs-1789101197540
logs: Queued 2 production steps on 2 CPU threads.
pdb2gmx rebuilds hydrogen coordinates with Amber99SB-ILDN templates (-ignh); all input heavy atoms must be retained. Default termini and protonation require review. No ligand parameterization.
$ /Users/ashujo/Documents/Science/DynaMol/.gromacs/bin/gmx pdb2gmx -f input.pdb -o processed.gro -p topol.top -ff amber99sb-ildn -water tip3p -ignh
$ /Users/ashujo/Documents/Science/DynaMol/.gromacs/bin/gmx genion -s ions.tpr -o system.gro -p topol.top -pname NA -nname CL -neutral -seed 42 -n added-solvent.ndx
Added TIP3P solvent and neutralizing ions, replacing only newly added waters; retained input crystal waters. 1 nm cubic padding. NVT at fixed volume; no pressure equilibration or added salt.
$ /Users/ashujo/Documents/Science/DynaMol/.gromacs/bin/gmx mdrun -deffnm minimize -ntmpi 1 -ntomp 2 -nb cpu -pme cpu -bonded cpu -update cpu -pin off
$ /Users/ashujo/Documents/Science/DynaMol/.gromacs/bin/gmx mdrun -deffnm production -ntmpi 1 -ntomp 2 -nb cpu -pme cpu -bonded cpu -update cpu -pin off
Complete: 3 frames, 26,818 atoms. Output files and reproducibility manifest saved.

artifacts.test: audit: ligand details, explicit-state SMILES and pH trigger real inspection updates
artifacts.name: ligand-inspection.json

warnings: Ligands are retained with their bound heavy-atom coordinates. Preparation assigns a recorded fixed protonation state and GAFF2 / AM1-BCC parameters for explicit-water OpenMM dynamics.
No retained SEQRES/mmCIF polymer sequence is available. Residue numbering gaps cannot identify which amino acids are absent, so loop building is unavailable.
pH assignment uses OpenMM template/heuristic protonation and histidine tautomer rules, not a pKa calculation or constant-pH simulation.

ligands.protonation_method: Explicit user SMILES defines chemistry and fixed protonation state.
warnings: Original input ligand chemistry was unavailable or did not match the bound pose; the explicit user chemical reference was used. It is not a binding-site pKa assignment.

reference.mapping_method: Unique element/connectivity match between explicit SMILES and bound-distance connectivity; chemical bond orders/charge come exclusively from SMILES.

ligands.stereo_limitations: Carbon tetrahedral CCD/input-SMILES configurations are checked. Nitrogen inversion, atropisomerism, and phosphorus stereodescriptors after ionization are not validated; the original bound heavy-atom pose is retained.

metal_environment.method: Observed metal–N/O/S contacts within 2.8 Å (3.2 Å for Ca); these distances do not establish bond order or validate a metal model.
